lede: Bernalillo marks Christmas with a town tree and water tower lighting, a nighttime parade on Camino del Pueblo and a library celebration with Santa.
celebrates: The Town of Bernalillo kicks off the season with its Christmas Tree and Water Tower Lighting at Town Hall, where families can also hang a memorial ornament for a loved one. The next night brings the nighttime Christmas parade, themed Route 66 in 2026. The town's winter events page also lists a Brighten Bernalillo contest, Santa Claus in Bernalillo and a Children's Christmas Gift Fund. Martha Liebert Public Library adds a Christmas Celebration with face painting, cookie decorating and Santa.
lastyear: In 2025 the Town of Bernalillo held a weekend of Christmas events. The town's Instagram said the water tower and Christmas tree would be lit on Friday, December 5, and a Bernalillo museum listing put the Christmas parade on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 6:30 to 8 pm. The town's Children's Christmas Gift Fund page says Santa Claus handed out presents to 385 children from over 150 families in Bernalillo.
facts: The Town of Bernalillo's lighting event is tied to its water tower as well as its Christmas tree, so the flyer names both. The town's parade has run in the evening for the past two years, at 6:30 pm. Martha Liebert Public Library has served Bernalillo since 1963, and its December 2026 calendar includes a family Christmas program with the Enchantment Albuquerque Handbell Choir, which the library calls annual.
trains: Bernalillo has no train listing on this site, but families can ride Sky Railway's Pablo's Holiday Express from the Lamy Depot near Santa Fe on December 5, 6, 12, 13 and 17 to 24. The one-hour ride features Mrs. Claus, story time, sing-alongs and hot cocoa. See the Santa Fe guide for the full listing and ticket prices.

faq: When is the Bernalillo Christmas parade in 2026?

The Town of Bernalillo holds its nighttime Christmas parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6:30 pm. The 2026 theme is Route 66. The town's flyer does not print a route, so check with the Community Development Office at 505-771-7133 before the parade for route details.
When is the Bernalillo tree lighting?

The Christmas Tree and Water Tower Lighting is Friday, December 4, 2026, at 6 pm at Town Hall, 829 Camino del Pueblo. The flyer says families can celebrate a loved one by hanging a memorial ornament on the tree and should contact Community Development for details.
Where can kids meet Santa in Bernalillo?

Martha Liebert Public Library's Christmas Celebration on Saturday, December 5, from 10 to 11:30 am lists a chance to meet Santa and Mrs. Claus, along with face painting, ornament decorating and cookie decorating. The library's calendar does not print a price.
Does Santa give presents in Bernalillo?

The town's Children's Christmas Gift Fund page says that in 2025 Santa Claus handed out Christmas presents to 385 children from over 150 families. The page lists phone numbers for the fund, 505-771-7120 and 505-771-7122, so call for this year's details.
